user.title: EdgeDecision
user.description: Local voice-command engine (EdgeDecision add-on). The address is found automatically when the add-on is running. If it is not: http://<add-on host name>:8765, usually http://a974f757-edgedecision:8765 (the host name is shown on the add-on page, or take the code in its web address and replace "_" with "-").

data.fallback_agent: Agent for sentences EdgeDecision cannot handle (conditions, questions, chit-chat)
data.execute: Execute the commands (off = only decide and answer)

error.cannot_connect: The EdgeDecision add-on does not answer at this address. Is it started, in mode homeassistant? Usually the address is http://a974f757-edgedecision:8765.
